short.q: Explain what "Al-Fatiha" means and why it has that name.
short.answer: Al-Fatiha means The Opening. It is the first surah of the Qur'an and it opens every prayer.
short.working: 1 mark for meaning, 1 mark for first surah, 1 mark for opening the prayer.

short.q: What lesson do we learn from Surah Al-Masad?
short.answer: Wealth and family connections cannot save a person who refuses the truth and harms good people. We should avoid pride and harm.
short.working: 1 mark for wealth cannot save, 1 mark for harming others is wrong, 1 mark for avoiding pride.

short.q: How can you apply the teaching of Al-Falaq about envy in your daily life?
short.answer: Seek Allah's protection from envy, be happy when others do well, and do not wish harm on them.
short.working: 1 mark for seeking refuge, 1 mark for being happy for others, 1 mark for not wishing harm.

short.q: State two lessons a child can learn from the Prophet's youth.
short.answer: Honest work is honourable, and a person can be good even if poor or an orphan.
short.working: 1 mark for each lesson.

short.q: What can a person say if they forget Bismillah at the start of the meal?
short.answer: "Bismillahi awwalahu wa akhirahu" meaning "In the name of Allah at its beginning and its end."
short.working: 1 mark for the words and 1 mark for the meaning.

short.q: Write the hadith on brushing teeth given in your syllabus.
short.answer: Brushing of teeth is a means of purification of the mouth and pleases Allah.
short.working: 1 mark for purification and 1 mark for pleasing Allah.

short.q: Give two good habits that keep a toothbrush healthy.
short.answer: Do not share it and change it when the bristles are bent.
short.working: 1 mark for each habit.

short.q: Describe three Islamic manners to observe during games.
short.answer: Dress modestly, keep the times of prayer, avoid cheating and insults, respect others.
short.working: 1 mark for each manner.

short.q: Give the meanings of Ar-Rahman, Ar-Rahim and Al-Malik.
short.answer: Ar-Rahman: the Most Kind; Ar-Rahim: the Most Merciful; Al-Malik: the King and Owner.
short.working: 1 mark for each.

short.q: How does the name Al-Malik help us to use our belongings wisely?
short.answer: Everything belongs to Allah, so we should use what we have responsibly, share and be thankful.
short.working: 1 mark for Allah as Owner, 1 mark for responsible use, 1 mark for sharing or gratitude.

short.q: Explain how belief in Raqib and Atid helps a child behave well.
short.answer: Words and actions are recorded, so the child speaks the truth, avoids wrong and does good, and repents when wrong.
short.working: 1 mark for recorded deeds, 1 mark for good behaviour, 1 mark for repentance.

short.q: Distinguish between a nabi and a rasul.
short.answer: A nabi is a prophet who receives revelation; a rasul is a prophet given a message or book to deliver.
short.working: 1 mark for each.

short.q: How did Prophet Ibrahim (A.S.) show generosity?
short.answer: When guests came, he quickly brought a fattened calf to serve them and welcomed them.
short.working: 1 mark for guests, 1 mark for the food, 1 mark for welcome.

short.q: What does twahara mean and why is it important?
short.answer: Twahara means purity. It is a condition for prayer and other acts of worship.
short.working: 1 mark for meaning and 1 mark for importance.

short.q: Describe how to clean a place licked by a dog.
short.answer: Wash seven times with water, one washing being mixed with clean soil, then rinse and dry.
short.working: 1 mark for seven washings, 1 mark for soil once, 1 mark for rinsing.

short.q: List the steps of wudhu in order from the hands to the feet.
short.answer: Hands, mouth, nose, face, arms to elbows, wipe head and ears, feet to ankles.
short.working: 1 mark for each three steps in the right order.

short.q: State three times when it is recommended to be in wudhu.
short.answer: Before prayer, before touching the Qur'an, before sleeping, before reciting Qur'an.
short.working: 1 mark for each.

short.q: Name the five daily prayers in order and give the rak'ahs of any two.
short.answer: Fajr (2), Dhuhr (4), Asr (4), Maghrib (3), Isha (4). Any two with correct rak'ahs.
short.working: 1 mark for names in order and 2 marks for two rak'ahs.

short.q: List the first four pillars of swalah.
short.answer: Niyyah, qiyam, takbiratul ihram, and reciting Al-Fatiha.
short.working: 1 mark for each.

short.q: Explain tartib in swalah.
short.answer: Doing the pillars in the correct order.
short.working: 1 mark for order and 1 mark for an example.

short.q: How can planting a tree be an act of worship?
short.answer: People or animals eat from it, and this counts as charity for the planter.
short.working: 1 mark for charity and 1 mark for eating from it.

short.q: Explain the meaning of modesty in dressing.
short.answer: Modesty is haya. It means covering properly and dressing decently without showing off.
short.working: 1 mark for haya, 1 mark for covering, 1 mark for not showing off.

short.q: Name two dressing trends a Muslim should avoid.
short.answer: Tight or see-through clothes, and clothes with rude words or pictures.
short.working: 1 mark for each.

short.q: List three rules for staying safe online.
short.answer: Never share passwords or address, ask parents' permission, tell an adult about anything uncomfortable.
short.working: 1 mark for each.

short.q: Explain the hadith "The upper hand is better than the lower hand".
short.answer: The giving hand is better than the receiving hand. A Muslim should try to work and give rather than depend on others.
short.working: 1 mark for giver better, 1 mark for work, 1 mark for the lesson.

short.q: Write the meaning of the dua for leaving the house.
short.answer: In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah, and there is no might and no power except with Allah.
short.working: 1 mark for each of the three parts.

short.q: Give three manners of making dua.
short.answer: Begin with praise, face the Qibla and raise hands, be humble, be patient, say Amin.
short.working: 1 mark for each.

short.q: Why is it important for parents to fulfil their obligations?
short.answer: Children grow safe and well-behaved, the family and community are strong, and parents earn Allah's reward.
short.working: 1 mark for each valid reason.

short.q: Explain what Qur'an 17:23-24 teaches about treating parents.
short.answer: Do not say "uff", speak kindly, be humble and make dua for them.
short.working: 1 mark for each of three teachings.

short.q: What can children do for parents who have passed away?
short.answer: Make dua for them, give charity on their behalf, keep good relations with their friends and relatives.
short.working: 1 mark for each.

short.q: What warning did the Prophet give about cutting family ties?
short.answer: The one who cuts family ties will not enter Paradise. So we should keep ties strong.
short.working: 1 mark for the warning, 1 mark for the meaning, 1 mark for the lesson.

short.q: In which cave, and near which city, did the first revelation come?
short.answer: The cave of Hira near Makkah.
short.working: 1 mark for the cave and 1 mark for the city.

short.q: Why was the Prophet (S.A.W.) called Al-Amin?
short.answer: People trusted him with their valuables because he was honest and returned them.
short.working: 1 mark for honest, 1 mark for trust, 1 mark for keeping trust.

short.q: Describe how Ali (R.A.) accepted Islam and what he did as a young man.
short.answer: He saw the Prophet and Khadija praying, asked, and accepted Islam. He was loyal and brave and slept in the Prophet's bed on the night of the migration.
short.working: 1 mark for each of the points.

short.q: Why did the Prophet (S.A.W.) go to Taif?
short.answer: To invite the people of Taif to Islam after losing Khadija and Abu Talib.
short.working: 1 mark for inviting and 1 mark for the reason.

short.q: Describe what happened to Taif in later years.
short.answer: In later years its people accepted Islam, and many descendants of those who rejected the Prophet became Muslims.
short.working: 1 mark for each of the points.
